# Vendored front-end libraries

These files are served locally so the interface does not depend on a CDN at runtime.

| File | Package | Version | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `axios.min.js` | axios | 1.20.0 | MIT | <https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/axios@1.20.0/dist/axios.min.js> |
| `marked.umd.js` | marked | 18.1.1 | MIT | <https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked@18.1.1/lib/marked.umd.js> |
| `purify.min.js` | DOMPurify | 3.4.17 | MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0 | <https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dompurify@3.4.17/dist/purify.min.js> |

Copyright and license notices are preserved in the header of each file. Full license texts are available from the upstream packages.
